sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: mathematics/related bachelor’s with at least 120 ECTS-equivalent mathematics and B2 English;
university catalogue adds German-equivalent minimum grade 2.5. US-credit equivalence must be assessed,
not assumed. Non-EU-degree preparation is assessed in analysis, linear algebra, numerical mathematics,
probability/discrete mathematics and an advanced area; an aptitude assessment may be requested. BIGS
normally requires a mathematics master’s/equivalent; exceptional bachelor admission is possible, and IMPRS
describes qualifying-year entry. Ask BIGS whether the specific UChicago preparation qualifies before treating
this as a direct-PhD route. [a] [b] [d] [f]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose MSc versus exceptional bachelor-to-BIGS route. MSc: assemble PDFs and one referee, English-medium
evidence and optional thesis/papers; assess GRE Mathematics timing. BIGS: discuss exceptional bachelor
eligibility with early-careers@hcm.uni-bonn.de, prepare two referees and a substantial mathematical work
sample, identify interests/advisers and funding preference, then apply to the current MathJobs call. [a] [d] [e]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
BIGS motivation letter asks whether a suitable faculty member is known/contacted, but does not require
universal prior approval. Contact is especially useful for exceptional bachelor eligibility and project funding.
MPIM and university jointly provide supervision; current IMPRS includes directors Gaitsgory, Scholze, Stroppel
and others. Emeritus names require explicit availability confirmation. [d] [f] [l] [m]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
MSc uses Bonn’s dedicated master portal; incomplete applications and emailed application documents are not
processed. BIGS current 2027 call uses MathJobs online uploads including confidential letters. Follow the
current call over older generic email language. Portal-only MSc invitation timing and receipt/replacement
remain unverified. [a] [d] [e] [i] [j] [k]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
BIGS HCM-PHD27 is an explicit 2027 recruitment call due6December 2026. MSc standing annual deadlines are
published, but a datedJanuary 2027 event conflicts about international eligibility. The standing April 15 doctoral
round has not been independently confirmed as a separate2027call. [a] [c] [d] [e]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Conflict]
BIGS current call: 6 December 2026 at 23:59:59 as displayed on MathJobs; timezone is not printed in the
retrieved advertisement. Start should be no later than October 2027. Standing second round closes April 15,
but no separate dated April-2027 call verified. MSc standing page permits international applications annually
January 15 and May 15; however a calendar entry for 15 January 2027 says domestic applicants only. This
conflict requires confirmation from apply@math.uni-bonn.de. Do not rely on the August domestic-only round.
[a] [c] [d] [e]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
The current Hausdorff/IMPRS doctoral application, including references, is due 6 December 2026. Admission
alone does not guarantee funding. MSc admission brings no scholarship; DAAD and other awards have
separate calls and deadlines, not established universally here. [a] [d] [e] [f]
Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
BIGS current employer call explicitly requires both letters by 6 December 2026 (displayed cutoff 23:59:59;
timezone unconfirmed). MSc is incomplete until its one letter arrives; no separate grace period is published.
Use the confirmed applicable MSc application deadline once the January conflict is resolved. [a] [e]

MSc English proof belongs in the complete application; recommended Mathematics GRE should be taken
before applying. No later score grace date was found. BIGS current call includes English evidence among
materials due 6 December 2026; precise acceptable equivalent proof should be confirmed for UChicago. [a] [e]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]

end of their first semester, following offer/enrollment instructions. [a] [e]

Late enrollment needs Mathematics Examination Committee approval. BIGS commitment deadline is
offer-specific and not stated in the public current call. [a] [e]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc requires CEFR B2; current opened page accepts an appropriate TOEFL/IELTS score, B2 coursework
evidence, or English-medium bachelor’s proof. Its indexed earlier extract gives TOEFL79/IELTS6, but the
opened current text no longer states those numbers, so rely on B2 and confirm exact tests if needed. BIGS
requires English proficiency, no German; current call requires evidence. IMPRS accepts TOEFL or equivalent
qualification, without a public numeric cutoff. [a] [d] [e] [f]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
MSc explicitly accepts proof that the bachelor’s teaching language was English, so obtain UChicago
registrar/degree evidence if the transcript does not establish it. Non-native nationality does not defeat this
route. For BIGS/IMPRS, an English-medium UChicago degree may be equivalent evidence but an automatic
US-degree waiver is not explicitly documented; confirm acceptable proof. [a] [e] [f]
GRE General [Standing rule]
No GRE General requirement appears in the MSc or BIGS current requirements. Optional General-score
acceptance is not stated. [a] [d] [e]

GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
MSc recommends the Mathematics GRE for applicants whose bachelor’s was outside the EU, including
UChicago; recommended is not required. ETS institution code6301. BIGS current call does not list a
Mathematics GRE requirement. [a] [e]

transcript/degree and latest master transcript if applicable, with planned final-term courses; bachelor-only

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required both routes. MSc: tabular PDF covering school and university education, with optional further
activities. BIGS: concise education from high school onward, academic/nonacademic work and achievements
such as publications, awards, scholarships or presentations. No public page-count limit found. [a] [d] [e]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
MSc required motivation letter in English/German: faithful paraphrase - why Bonn, main mathematical interest
and experience in it; no public length limit. BIGS required motivation/cover letter maximum 2pages: faithful
paraphrase - why a mathematics PhD and Bonn, intended area and background, and any known/contacted
suitable Bonn faculty. Upload PDF. [a] [d] [e]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate personal/background essay is listed for either route; no permission for extra unsolicited essay
established. [a] [d] [e]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Required within motivation letter: name the main area and preparation; BIGS also asks whether a potential
adviser is known or contacted. No separate research-interest document is specified. [a] [d]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
A full standalone research proposal is not listed for the MSc or current BIGS call. BIGS requires a mathematical
work sample instead. External scholarship proposals, if any, depend on the award. [a] [d] [e]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
MSc: if available, submit bachelor’s thesis or other academic papers; include English summary if not
English/German. BIGS: required substantial English mathematics sample - thesis/draft/chapter, substantial
publication or work in preparation, or a detailed informative thesis abstract. Current MathJobs slot specifically
names MSc thesis/chapter/extended abstract; bachelor-only candidates must confirm an acceptable substitute.
PDF upload, BIGS≤2MB; no public length limit. [a] [d] [e]
Publications list [Standing rule]
BIGS includes publications among CV achievements; substantial published/in-progress work may fulfill the
sample requirement. No separate publications-list document is prescribed. MSc accepts academic papers if
available. Uploads are requested; linking alone is not established as sufficient. [a] [d] [e]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
No separate MSc form listed. BIGS must include final-term current/planned courses with the academic record;
exact format/length not specified. [a] [d]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
The BIGS application asks whether personal funding is secured/in progress and which funding routes are
sought. No separate Hausdorff/IMPRS essay prompt is listed. External DAAD/foundation applications may
require additional essays and documents; exact prompts require the chosen award/citizenship. [d] [e] [f]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
BIGS form asks funding preference/status and visa requirements. No additional public short-answer limits
established. Current call’s master-specific transcript/sample slots require clarification for exceptional bachelor
applicants. [d] [e]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
MSc: no tuition, but semester contribution and living costs; no admission-linked scholarship. Hausdorff doctoral
positions:75%TV-L E13 employment. Standing BIGS page estimates €2,000-€2,300 net/month depending on
circumstances (annual arithmetic €24,000-€27,600 net across12months), with healthcare/social-security
benefits. This estimate is not an individualized or indexed 2027 salary promise. The current call confirms pay
scale, not exact euros. [a] [d] [e] [g] [h]
Years of support [2027 confirmed]
Current HCM-PHD27 positions are three years with possible one-year extension; start no later than October
2027. IMPRS describes completing PhD in 3-4years; actual support contract governs. MSc standard length two
years and no guaranteed maintenance. [a] [e] [f]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
IMPRS explicitly accepts all countries; BIGS recruits internationally, and the current employment call welcomes
applicants regardless of origin. MSc international students also pay no tuition, but must finance living costs and
semester contributions. [a] [e] [f] [h]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
BIGS admission does not automatically include funding. Hausdorff positions target students ready for
dissertation research; salary depends on employment terms and personal deductions. Bachelor
exception/qualifying-year funding must be confirmed separately. MSc admission alone supplies no scholarship.
[a] [d] [e] [f]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Current MathJobs application permits Hausdorff and IMPRS consideration; indicate funding interest/status.
External scholarships require their own applications. No separate automatic MSc maintenance application was
identified. [a] [d] [e]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
IMPRS Moduli Spaces, DAAD and German/foreign foundations are named official alternatives. Some German
foundations support foreign doctoral students in Germany. Eligibility, exact amounts and essays are
award-specific and cannot be derived from F-1 status. [d] [f] [h] [n]
Application fee [Standing rule]
Bonn’s university costs page states applying for admission is free. No programme-specific additional fee
appears in the MSc or current BIGS call. Semester contribution is separate from application fee and tuition. [a]
[e] [g]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
No waiver needed for the published free application. Semester-charge reductions are a different matter and
not an application-fee waiver. [g]

University of Bonn / BIGS Mathematics /
MPIM
Germany · MSc Mathematics; BIGS Mathematics doctorate; IMPRS Moduli Spaces
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• MSc January 2027 international eligibility conflicts across official pages.
• MSc recommends Mathematics GRE for a US bachelor’s.
• Bachelor-to-PhD admission is exceptional; do not assume ordinary eligibility.
• MSc admission does not include maintenance funding.
• Current BIGS call overrides generic emailed-reference wording.
• Current PhD call contains master-specific fields: bachelor-only applicants need guidance.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: mathematics/related bachelor’s with at least 120 ECTS-equivalent mathematics and B2 English;
university catalogue adds German-equivalent minimum grade 2.5. US-credit equivalence must be assessed,
not assumed. Non-EU-degree preparation is assessed in analysis, linear algebra, numerical mathematics,
probability/discrete mathematics and an advanced area; an aptitude assessment may be requested. BIGS
normally requires a mathematics master’s/equivalent; exceptional bachelor admission is possible, and IMPRS
describes qualifying-year entry. Ask BIGS whether the specific UChicago preparation qualifies before treating
this as a direct-PhD route. [a] [b] [d] [f]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose MSc versus exceptional bachelor-to-BIGS route. MSc: assemble PDFs and one referee, English-medium
evidence and optional thesis/papers; assess GRE Mathematics timing. BIGS: discuss exceptional bachelor
eligibility with early-careers@hcm.uni-bonn.de, prepare two referees and a substantial mathematical work
sample, identify interests/advisers and funding preference, then apply to the current MathJobs call. [a] [d] [e]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
BIGS motivation letter asks whether a suitable faculty member is known/contacted, but does not require
universal prior approval. Contact is especially useful for exceptional bachelor eligibility and project funding.
MPIM and university jointly provide supervision; current IMPRS includes directors Gaitsgory, Scholze, Stroppel
and others. Emeritus names require explicit availability confirmation. [d] [f] [l] [m]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
MSc uses Bonn’s dedicated master portal; incomplete applications and emailed application documents are not
processed. BIGS current 2027 call uses MathJobs online uploads including confidential letters. Follow the
current call over older generic email language. Portal-only MSc invitation timing and receipt/replacement
remain unverified. [a] [d] [e] [i] [j] [k]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
BIGS HCM-PHD27 is an explicit 2027 recruitment call due6December 2026. MSc standing annual deadlines are
published, but a datedJanuary 2027 event conflicts about international eligibility. The standing April 15 doctoral
round has not been independently confirmed as a separate2027call. [a] [c] [d] [e]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [Conflict]
BIGS current call: 6 December 2026 at 23:59:59 as displayed on MathJobs; timezone is not printed in the
retrieved advertisement. Start should be no later than October 2027. Standing second round closes April 15,
but no separate dated April-2027 call verified. MSc standing page permits international applications annually
January 15 and May 15; however a calendar entry for 15 January 2027 says domestic applicants only. This
conflict requires confirmation from apply@math.uni-bonn.de. Do not rely on the August domestic-only round.
[a] [c] [d] [e]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
The current Hausdorff/IMPRS doctoral application, including references, is due 6 December 2026. Admission
alone does not guarantee funding. MSc admission brings no scholarship; DAAD and other awards have
separate calls and deadlines, not established universally here. [a] [d] [e] [f]
Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
BIGS current employer call explicitly requires both letters by 6 December 2026 (displayed cutoff 23:59:59;
timezone unconfirmed). MSc is incomplete until its one letter arrives; no separate grace period is published.
Use the confirmed applicable MSc application deadline once the January conflict is resolved. [a] [e]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
MSc English proof belongs in the complete application; recommended Mathematics GRE should be taken
before applying. No later score grace date was found. BIGS current call includes English evidence among
materials due 6 December 2026; precise acceptable equivalent proof should be confirmed for UChicago. [a] [e]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
BIGS complete required documents and two letters due 6 December 2026. MSc application documents must be
complete by the applicable round deadline; final bachelor completion is required by September 30 for October
entry (March 31 for April entry). International MSc graduates may submit final graduation documents by the
end of their first semester, following offer/enrollment instructions. [a] [e]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
MSc admission letter specifies enrollment deadline; generally enrollment must finish before lectures begin.
Late enrollment needs Mathematics Examination Committee approval. BIGS commitment deadline is
offer-specific and not stated in the public current call. [a] [e]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc requires CEFR B2; current opened page accepts an appropriate TOEFL/IELTS score, B2 coursework
evidence, or English-medium bachelor’s proof. Its indexed earlier extract gives TOEFL79/IELTS6, but the
opened current text no longer states those numbers, so rely on B2 and confirm exact tests if needed. BIGS
requires English proficiency, no German; current call requires evidence. IMPRS accepts TOEFL or equivalent
qualification, without a public numeric cutoff. [a] [d] [e] [f]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
MSc explicitly accepts proof that the bachelor’s teaching language was English, so obtain UChicago
registrar/degree evidence if the transcript does not establish it. Non-native nationality does not defeat this
route. For BIGS/IMPRS, an English-medium UChicago degree may be equivalent evidence but an automatic
US-degree waiver is not explicitly documented; confirm acceptable proof. [a] [e] [f]
GRE General [Standing rule]
No GRE General requirement appears in the MSc or BIGS current requirements. Optional General-score
acceptance is not stated. [a] [d] [e]

GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
MSc recommends the Mathematics GRE for applicants whose bachelor’s was outside the EU, including
UChicago; recommended is not required. ETS institution code6301. BIGS current call does not list a
Mathematics GRE requirement. [a] [e]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
MSc uploads current transcript and diploma/final certificate when available. BIGS requires bachelor
transcript/degree and latest master transcript if applicable, with planned final-term courses; bachelor-only
exceptions must ask how to replace master-specific fields. BIGS files must be ordinary PDF, at most2MB,
filenames without special characters; documents English/German with certified translations for other-language
degree certificates. [a] [d] [e]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
BIGS requests information about courses currently taken or planned in the final term alongside the latest
transcript. MSc public checklist does not prescribe a separate math-course-list form; transcripts must establish
mathematics volume/preparation. [a] [d]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
No standalone syllabus/course-description upload is listed. Bonn evaluates equivalence against its own
bachelor curriculum; prepare descriptions if requested during aptitude evaluation, without assuming
unsolicited uploads are permitted. [a] [b]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
MSc international applicant: one referee. BIGS standing instructions say at least two; the current HCM-PHD27
call requires two. [a] [d] [e]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Hausdorff and IMPRS screening use the same doctoral application and two letters; no additional scholarship
referee or separate question set is published. DAAD/other external award references are award-specific. [d] [e]
[f]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
MSc automatically contacts the entered referee, but public wording does not resolve whether saving details or
submitting triggers the email. BIGS general page says automatic contact; the current call uses MathJobs,
whose help describes an email-notification choice on the cover sheet. Inspect and activate the request control
deliberately. [a] [d] [e] [k]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
No universal after-submission-only rule established. MathJobs references can be managed through the cover
sheet independently of a particular job application; MSc exact trigger is unresolved. [a] [e] [k]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
BIGS MathJobs status screen shows receipt dates next to referees and application completeness. MSc public
admissions page does not document a letter-receipt indicator; verify in the portal or with the office. [a] [e] [j]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
MathJobs writers can update letters and restrict which employers see them; generic letters can serve multiple
applications subject to those restrictions. Do not replace a tailored letter needed by an active application. MSc
letter replacement/reuse was not established in public guidance. [a] [i] [k]

Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required both routes. MSc: tabular PDF covering school and university education, with optional further
activities. BIGS: concise education from high school onward, academic/nonacademic work and achievements
such as publications, awards, scholarships or presentations. No public page-count limit found. [a] [d] [e]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
MSc required motivation letter in English/German: faithful paraphrase - why Bonn, main mathematical interest
and experience in it; no public length limit. BIGS required motivation/cover letter maximum 2pages: faithful
paraphrase - why a mathematics PhD and Bonn, intended area and background, and any known/contacted
suitable Bonn faculty. Upload PDF. [a] [d] [e]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate personal/background essay is listed for either route; no permission for extra unsolicited essay
established. [a] [d] [e]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Required within motivation letter: name the main area and preparation; BIGS also asks whether a potential
adviser is known or contacted. No separate research-interest document is specified. [a] [d]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
A full standalone research proposal is not listed for the MSc or current BIGS call. BIGS requires a mathematical
work sample instead. External scholarship proposals, if any, depend on the award. [a] [d] [e]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
MSc: if available, submit bachelor’s thesis or other academic papers; include English summary if not
English/German. BIGS: required substantial English mathematics sample - thesis/draft/chapter, substantial
publication or work in preparation, or a detailed informative thesis abstract. Current MathJobs slot specifically
names MSc thesis/chapter/extended abstract; bachelor-only candidates must confirm an acceptable substitute.
PDF upload, BIGS≤2MB; no public length limit. [a] [d] [e]
Publications list [Standing rule]
BIGS includes publications among CV achievements; substantial published/in-progress work may fulfill the
sample requirement. No separate publications-list document is prescribed. MSc accepts academic papers if
